name: jk-hospital-platform
description: Production-grade hospital appointment and token management platform for JK Hospital.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend --if-present && npm run test --prefix frontend --if-present
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high --prefix backend && npm audit --audit-level=high --prefix frontend
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run dev
